name: aeolus
description: Crew an Aeolus ship from a Codex session, keep its identity per folder and follow the fleet protocol.

interface.longDescription: Crew an Aeolus fleet ship from Codex, keep its identity per working folder, restore it when the task resumes and follow the durable ship messaging protocol. Automatic local wake-up is supported in Codex Desktop and CLI; Codex Cloud cannot wake automatically.
defaultPrompt: Show the Aeolus ship this folder crews.
